title: The second draw of stale, unrun test suites, run before judged

scope.intent: Machine-readable verdict record for the sixteen suites in the T-472 draw: the fourteen the census named at directory grain, plus the two its per-file mode resolved.

verdictVocabulary.note: The acceptance names 'the three verdicts T-509 established' as wire_into_ci, rewrite_as_behavior and update_with_reason_recorded. T-509's own record establishes repair, update_with_reason_recorded and rewrite_as_behavior: wire_into_ci is not in it, and repair is. The two sets disagree by one member each.
verdictVocabulary.resolution: Use the union of four. This draw needs both of the disputed members and would be falsified by either three-member set: eleven files are green and proven safe, which only wire_into_ci describes, and one file is correct-and-red about live behavior, which only repair describes.
verdictVocabulary.rewriteAsBehaviorWhyNot: T-509's draw was nine source-text scanners and every one earned it. This draw contains none: the only file that touches the filesystem reads a data manifest, and the rest render or drive real handlers.

premiseCorrections: The item is filed under 'stale, unrun test suites'. Eleven of the sixteen are GREEN. Unrun is measured; stale was assumed, and for two thirds of this draw it is false: these are current contracts that no workflow names.
T-509's premise correction was that every one of its twenty was red. That does not generalize; it was a property of that directory, not of the pool.

The acceptance's fallback, 'if the script has no per-file mode, say so and file that as the finding', resolves the other way. scripts/quality/test-ci-coverage-census.mjs --explain already reports unrun status per file, and the six 'unresolvable' files were resolvable all along.

Of those six, four already carry a T-509 verdict (atlas-ask-route, deliverable-render-contract, marketing-nav-dropdowns, sign-in-shell). The census still counts them untriaged because its 'triaged' means 'excluded by a naming command's --testPathIgnorePatterns', not 'a human wrote a verdict'. Two were genuinely new, and this record holds them.

batches.what: the fourteen named at directory grain
the two resolved by the census's per-file mode

jestEvidence.runTestsByPathWhy: Four of the sixteen paths contain [contractId], [scope] or [artifactId]. A bare jest pattern is a regex and those are character classes, so a pattern run silently matches nothing and reports a clean slate.

swallowProbe.why: T-469 classifies the data-plane clients. The pg-backed family CONNECTS and is already guarded repo-wide by src/testing/pg-test-boundary.ts, which throws by name. postgresCompat SWALLOWS: it resolves to {data:null} with the failure in a side channel and no socket, so a suite behind it can be green because its read failed. Green is therefore not evidence until that case is excluded, and no gate excludes it.
swallowProbe.method: Re-ran the eleven green suites with a setup file that replaces getAzureReadFluentClient and getAzureWriteFluentClient with functions that throw a marker. Measurement only: the probe is not committed and is not part of CI.

negativeControl.why: A probe that cannot fire proves nothing, which is the exact defect this backlog was opened over.
negativeControl.how: A throwaway suite calling getAzureReadFluentClient().from('clients').select('*').limit(1), run both ways, then deleted.
negativeControl.withoutProbe: 1 passed, green on a swallowed null, reproducing the T-469 'swallows' verdict.

swallowProbe.result: 11 passed, 119 tests, identical to the unprobed run. Every wire_into_ci verdict below rests on this, not on green alone.

censusPerFileMode.question: The acceptance asks whether scripts/quality/test-ci-coverage-census.mjs can name unrun files rather than only counting them per directory.
censusPerFileMode.consequenceForT582: T-582 was filed on the premise that 'until a census entry resolves to a filename, every further draw is either a guess or nothing'. That blocker is false: --explain resolves the filename today. What T-582 asks for that does NOT exist is the loaded/collected/run/green grain per file, a different and still-open request. T-582 should be narrowed to that rather than closed.

evidence: Asserts res.headers.get('x-abarva-v6-surface') is 'moves'. That header name appears NOWHERE in src outside this file and its Source twin, checked at every commit that ever touched the pair (6c6596353, 7daf4e4c8, ea6ab5d52): the route's own count is 0 in all three.
The route does emit surface attribution, under a different name: MOVES_V6_SYNTHESIS_HEADERS sets X-AbarVa-V6-Contract, X-AbarVa-Moves-Layer: moves-current and X-AbarVa-Renderer-Policy.
Two further cases expect 200 and receive 404, so the fixture program no longer resolves.
suites.rationale: The contract is behavior-bearing and the control it names is present, under another header. The expectation is wrong about the name and has been wrong since it was written, so this is a stale assertion and NOT evidence of a deleted control. Saying otherwise would be the false alarm this backlog can least afford.
suites.currentAction: Do not repair here. T-517 refreshes the header name to the one the route emits and re-points the fixture; this item only records what was measured.

suites.rationale: This suite is not stale. It is correct, it is red, and it is red about live behavior on a client-facing surface: long Brief C advisor prose is truncated mid-argument on Source. It is the only file in the draw where the code is wrong rather than the test.

evidence: Four of seventy-six cases fail. Three are copy or fixture drift: '7 inputs available', '1 required next-phase prep item' and a canary deliverable title are no longer in the rendered output.
The fourth is a deliberate product change the test never followed: the artifact link is now /api/v1/artifacts/<id>?format=html&inline=1 and the expectation still reads ?inline=1.
It renders through Testing Library rather than scanning source text, so it is not the T-509 scanner pattern.
suites.rationale: Seventy-two green cases over a real rendered surface, four expectations that drifted. Deleting or weakening it to make the count go down is precisely the move this backlog exists to prevent.
suites.currentAction: Do not repair here. T-518 refreshes the four expectations against the current render, each with the reason recorded.
